issues.legal_issue: A conveyance made after attachment in performance of a sale agreement entered into before attachment passes title unaffected by the attachment.
material_facts: The property owner agreed to sell the land to the purchaser before a creditor attached it in execution of a decree.
The owner executed the sale deed after the attachment, in performance of the earlier agreement.
The High Court held that the sale was subject to the attachment.
issues.conclusion: The purchaser acquired good title despite the attachment; the sale was not subject to it. The appeal was allowed, the High Court’s order was reversed, and the trial court’s order was restored.
issues.legal_principle: An agreement for sale creates an obligation attached to ownership, although it does not itself create an interest in immovable property under Section 54 of the Transfer of Property Act. Under Section 40 of that Act and Section 91 of the Trusts Act, the contractual obligation may be enforced against a transferee with notice, and Order 38 Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure protects rights existing before attachment. An attaching creditor obtains only the judgment debtor’s right, title and interest and no greater right. Although Section 64 of the Code of Civil Procedure protects attaching creditors, it does not override an antecedent contractual obligation when the later conveyance performs the earlier agreement. The Court approved Paparaju Veeraraghavayya v. Killaru Kamala Devi, Veerappa Thevar v. C.S. Venkataramma Aiyar, Angu Pillai v. M.S.M. Kasiviswanathan Chettiar, Purna Chandra Basak v. Daulat Ali Mollah, Rango Ramachandra v. Gurlingappa Chinnappa, Yashvant Shankar Dunakhe v. Prayarji Nurji Tamboli, and Kochuponchi Varughese v. Quseph Lonan. It overruled Mohinder Singh v. Nanak Singh.

rule.if: execution_attachment_case and pre_attachment_sale_contract and post_attachment_conveyance and conveyance_performs_contract

predicates.execution_attachment_case: A creditor attached a debtor’s property in execution of a decree.
predicates.pre_attachment_sale_contract: The property owner entered into a contract to sell the property before the creditor attached it.
predicates.post_attachment_conveyance: The property owner conveyed the property to the purchaser after the attachment.
predicates.conveyance_performs_contract: The conveyance was made in performance of the earlier sale contract.
predicates.purchaser_receives_title_unaffected_by_a: The purchaser receives title unaffected by the attachment.

issues.definition: When a creditor attaches property in execution of a decree after the owner has contracted to sell it, and the owner later conveys it in performance of that contract, the purchaser receives title unaffected by the attachment.
